title: generate_all_charts.ipynb

canonical_node.axiom: All project visualizations shall be generated from a single, reproducible notebook execution, producing publication-ready charts in a consistent format.
definitions: Publication-ready: PNG format at 300 DPI, suitable for academic publication.
Consistent format: uniformly named, sized, and styled charts across all categories.
Single execution: one notebook run generates the complete visualization suite without requiring separate test runs.
derivation: The project produces multiple test results across field theory, Lagrangian mechanics, and biblical empirical studies.
Each test notebook focuses on proving results, not on visualization.
A separate chart generator notebook imports all data and produces all visualizations in one session.
This separation keeps tests clean and visualizations consistent.
The output directory structure organizes charts by category for easy access and integration.
canonical_node.action: Execute generate_all_charts.ipynb to generate all project visualizations, saving them to /content/charts/ in PNG format at 300 DPI, organized into field_theory/, lagrangian/, biblical/, and summary/ subdirectories.
boundary: Does not run the underlying tests; it only imports their data.
Does not perform new analysis; it only visualizes existing results.
Does not guarantee the correctness of the underlying data; it assumes test outputs are valid.
Does not produce interactive visualizations; output is static PNG files.
test: Run the notebook and verify that all expected chart files are created in the correct directories.
Check that each PNG is at 300 DPI and has the expected dimensions.
Compare the summary scorecard chart to the COLAB_MASTER output for consistency.
Verify that the charts accurately represent the underlying data by spot-checking a few against test outputs.

dg1_dependencies: All test notebooks that produce data (e.g., field theory tests, Lagrangian tests, biblical tests)
Data files generated by those tests
Python environment with required libraries (matplotlib, numpy, etc.)
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a single-command generation of all publication-ready visualizations, eliminating the need to run multiple notebooks and ensuring consistent formatting across all charts.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to generate individual charts from test notebooks if needed, as the chart generator does not modify test outputs.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this notebook, generating all charts would require running each test notebook individually and manually formatting outputs, increasing effort and risking inconsistency.

overstatement_risks: Claims of 'publication-ready' may overstate quality without external review.
May imply completeness of visualization suite without explicit list of all charts.
kill_conditions: If the notebook fails to run in a clean environment.
If the output charts are not reproducible across runs.
If the underlying data is invalid, the charts become misleading.
risk.lean_target: A script that generates all charts from a single command, with clear documentation of input data and output format.

plain_summary: This document describes a Colab notebook that generates all project visualizations in one run, saving them as high-resolution PNGs. It is an operational tool, not a scientific claim, and its value depends on the correctness of the underlying data.
